description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for reading and writing binary data (integers, characters, strings) to and from buffers related to the 'angel' component. It includes error handling, buffer management, and data serialization functions intended for inter-process communication, with specific considerations for platform compatibility and data size limits.

classes.name: liAngelBuffer
classes.description: A structure representing a buffer with data and current read/write position.

methods.name: li_angel_data_error_quark
methods.description: Returns a GQuark for identifying error domains related to angel data operations.

methods.name: li_angel_data_write_int32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_write_int64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_write_char
methods.description: Writes a character into the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_write_str
methods.description: Writes a GString as a string into the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_write_cstr
methods.description: Writes a C string of specified length into the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_read_int32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_read_int64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_read_char
methods.description: Reads a character from the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_read_str
methods.description: Reads a string from the buffer.

methods.name: li_angel_data_read_mem
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of memory (as a string) from the buffer.

ctags.name: LI_ANGEL_DATA_ERROR_EOF
ctags.pattern: /^	LI_ANGEL_DATA_ERROR_EOF,                    \/* not enough data to read value *\/$/

ctags.name: LI_ANGEL_DATA_ERROR_INVALID_STRING_LENGTH
ctags.pattern: /^	LI_ANGEL_DATA_ERROR_INVALID_STRING_LENGTH,  \/* invalid string length read from buffer (< 0 || /
